changes.holder-analysis-v1.1.0: Components 1, 2, 4-7 compute from stored holder panels, wallet-resolved trades, provider candles and address classes when those inputs exist; values for meaningful-holder growth and whale accumulation are now defined as ratios; trade coverage rules added. Results are unchanged while no such input is collected.

summary: Nine components in four areas. Raw values, histories, peer comparisons and coverage come first; a composite is a separate, versioned, gated framework that is disabled until its inputs are defensible.

inputs.panels: Holder panels are stored with the population the source declares (holder_panels, balance_checkpoints). A panel is complete only when the source says it covers every holder; no x4o2 panel does. Only token-unit amounts are used; USD values are never converted back into balances.
inputs.trades: Wallet-resolved trades come from one tape per coin whose responses are complete between the oldest returned trade and the read time (trade_coverage). Coverage of a window is the share of it inside those spans. Filtered feeds (FOMO activity) are context, never flow inputs.
inputs.supply: Circulating supply = circulating market cap / price from the same Codex snapshot.
inputs.addressClasses: docs/data/address-labels.json (evidence-backed) plus the pool addresses LAMBLE tracks for the coin. Unclassified pools and programs stay in the population and the coverage note says so.
inputs.checkpoints: Two checkpoints about 7 days apart, each within checkpointToleranceHours (default 24) of its target; the later within the component's maxAgeSeconds.

exclusions.policy: Excluded from holder populations only when classified with evidence: liquidity pools, burn addresses, custody/exchange wallets, lockups/vesting contracts and the token's own program accounts. A contract address is not excluded merely for being a contract (smart wallets hold tokens). Heuristic ownership clusters are reported separately and never merged into verified labels.
exclusions.sensitivity: Concentration is reported with and without each exclusion class so the effect of every exclusion is visible.

populations.all_holders: Every balance of the token on its chain at a checkpoint. Required for any measure labelled 'all holders'.
populations.top_holders_sample: The largest positions a source tracks (for example pump.holders, at most 100). Valid for top-N concentration when total supply is known; never for holder counts or retention of all holders.
populations.fomo_users: Holders who trade on FOMO (fomo.holders). Reported only as 'FOMO users'.
populations.recent_trades_sample: The most recent trades a tape returns. Valid only for the window it covers.

components.label: Holdings retained through drawdowns
components.formula: For a fixed cohort (holders at the episode peak checkpoint), sum(min(balance at trough, balance at peak)) / sum(balance at peak). Endpoint retention: a wallet that sold and rebought between checkpoints counts as retained only up to its trough balance; continuity is reported separately.
requires: all_holders balance checkpoints at peak and trough

components.label: Balance retention and uninterrupted holding
components.formula: endpointRetention = sum(min(b1, b0)) / sum(b0) over the cohort at t0. uninterruptedShare = share of the cohort's t0 balance held by wallets whose wallet-resolved history shows the balance never fell to zero between t0 and t1. Buy 100, sell 100, buy 100 is endpoint-retained but not uninterrupted.
requires: wallet-resolved transfer or trade history for continuity
components.temporalResolution: Checkpoint spacing is disclosed; exits and re-entries between checkpoints are invisible without transfer history.

components.label: Allocation to the token within the measured wallet portfolio
components.formula: token value / value of all measured assets in the same wallets, on the measured networks only. Never described as a share of anyone's whole portfolio.
requires: wallet balances across measured assets (no validated capability yet)

components.label: Meaningful-holder growth
components.formula: entrants = wallets at or above usdThreshold at t1 that were below it at t0 AND whose token balance increased. priceCrossers (balance unchanged or lower, crossed only because price rose) are reported separately and never counted as entrants. value = (after - priceCrossers - before) / before, where before and after count wallets at or above usdThreshold at each checkpoint (prices: snapshots within 12 hours of each checkpoint).

components.label: Accumulation by a fixed whale cohort
components.formula: Cohort = top 20 non-excluded wallets of a top-holder or all-holder panel about 7 days before the release, fixed for the comparison. netPurchases = sum(buy token amounts) - sum(sell token amounts) from wallet-resolved trades only; value = netPurchases / the cohort's starting balance. Transfers, airdrops and rebases change balances but are never purchases; balance change is reported separately. Requires trade coverage of the window >= minCoverage and token amounts on every cohort trade.

components.label: Buying that absorbs selling during dips
components.formula: Over daily intervals in the last lookbackDays whose close fell >= dipThreshold versus the prior day's close: sum(buyVolumeUsd) / sum(sellVolumeUsd) from wallet-resolved trades. A dip day counts only when its flow coverage (time inside complete trade spans, capped by traded USD against the day's total volume) is >= minCoverage, and at least minCoverage of dip days must count. No dip day: not_applicable.

components.label: Concentration under documented exclusions
components.formula: top10Share = sum(top 10 non-excluded balances) / circulating supply. Valid from a top-holders sample when supply is known; reported with each exclusion class toggled.

components.label: Liquidity relative to size
components.formula: liquidityUsd / circulatingMarketCapUsd from the same snapshot (codex.token-snapshot). Both are the source's figures for the token's top pair; circulating market cap, not FDV.

components.label: Performance against explicitly defined peers
components.formula: excessReturn7d = token 7-day price return - median 7-day return of the peer set. Peers = the other open members of the token's narratives on the evaluation date, each listed. Returns come from snapshot prices taken 7 days apart (+/- 12 hours); a token or peer without both prices is excluded and the peer count is reported.

composite.disabledReason: Seven of nine components have no validated input capability yet (no holder panels, wallet-resolved trades or portfolio data are collected; the store and methods accept them once a capability is enabled). A score over two market-health/relative components would not measure holders.
composite.missingPolicy: Missing components never raise a score: the score is published only when the gate passes, and then as a bound [missing at 0, missing at 100]; the point value is shown only when the bound is narrower than maxBoundWidth.
composite.interpretation: A relative description of holder structure on fixed references. Not a return probability and not a recommendation.
